values.website: A slim DIN-rail industrial gateway on MT7628 with 4G single-SIM, optional Wi-Fi 4, RS485, DI/O, and 5 Fast Ethernet ports running OpenWRT Linux. Suited for OEM embedded connectivity, factory floor network integration, and infrastructure equipment deployments.
values.catalogue: A slim DIN-rail industrial gateway on MT7628 with 4G single-SIM, optional Wi-Fi 4, RS485, DI/O, and 5 Fast Ethernet ports running OpenWRT Linux. Suited for OEM embedded connectivity, factory floor network integration, and infrastructure equipment deployments.

Single 4G MODEM
5× ETHERNET PORTS
Serial I/O RS485 · DI/O
Wi-Fi 4 2.4 GHz
9–30 V DC INPUT

Made in India
4G LTE
Wi-Fi 4
Fanless Design

values.website:
OEM Embedded Connectivity Solutions
Factory Floor Network Integration
Infrastructure Equipment Connectivity
values.catalogue:
OEM Embedded Connectivity Solutions — Suitable for OEMs and system integrators to embed secure cellular connectivity into industrial machines, smart cabinets, and custom automation systems.
Factory Floor Network Integration — Provides dependable connectivity for production equipment, HMI systems, and control panels in manufacturing environments requiring continuous communication.
Infrastructure Equipment Connectivity — Can be deployed in infrastructure systems such as parking management, access control, and roadside equipment for secure remote access and monitoring.
